shortDescription: Returns list of Remote Block Storage volumes.

options.name: endpoint
options.description: Endpoint to use to connect to API. Do not change until specifically asked to do otherwise. If not set, the value of the C(SERVERSCOM_API_URL) environment variable is used.

options.name: label_selector
options.description: A selector to filter volumes by labels. More info at https://developers.servers.com/api-documentation/v1/#section/Labels/Labels-selector

options.name: location_code
options.description: Human-readable location slug (mutually exclusive with I(location_id)).

options.name: search_pattern
options.description: A string to filter volumes by name or ID. If specified, the module will return only volumes names of which match the provided string.

options.name: token
options.description: Token to use. You can create token for your account in https://portal.servers.com in Profile -> Public API section. If not set, the value of the C(SERVERSCOM_API_TOKEN) or C(SC_TOKEN) environment variable is used (C(SERVERSCOM_API_TOKEN) takes precedence). Value is not logged.
